text.p: Swiss shares ended a shade lower after a slow directionless session but dealers expected favourable fundamentals, such as an easier Swiss franc, to lend support to the market in the near-term.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index closed 2.9 points lower at 3,696.6 points and the all-share Swiss Performance Index fell 1.58 points, or 0.07 percent, to 2,373.07.

Financials were largely disappointing but UBS bearer shares stood out with a gain of 10 francs, closing at 1,195. Dealers said the rise may have been due to hopes the bank would announce a restructuring in the near future.
Zurich Insurance, which said on Thursday its first-half net profit rose by 33 percent, fell two francs to 342.
